A simpler settings popup.

### Removed
- The "When a video is on both" setting. Videos aren't on both Nebula and Floatplane, so it never had anything to choose between. Results are ordered by your subscriptions, then a video match ahead of a channel link.

Everything else is as in [0.5.2](https://github.com/josh345rtfvqw/detour/releases/tag/v0.5.2).

**Install:** [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/detour/lofobnkomhhicgcpejnlcibekkaiaeed), [Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/detour-nebula-floatplane/), or load the zip below.
